comparison.objective: Reorient and stow a nailer without pointing it at a coworker, versus tuning a damper's stopping behavior.
comparison.physical_skill: Plan a safe rigid-tool orientation, possibly with a handoff; no socket engagement, collar setting, locking, or iterative physical testing.
comparison.success_condition: Nailer rests in its case without trigger contact or unsafe pointing; no damper performance or force limits.
comparison.reason: This evaluates hazard-aware transport and orientation rather than mechanical commissioning.
